title: Howard Hughes brought to the Bahamas

tellings.quote: the the island there. And you also have Howard Hughes, who suddenly gets brought down there.

plain: At some point the billionaire Howard Hughes was suddenly brought down to an island in the Bahamas, according to the researcher Jason Simosa. Simosa mentions it in passing, without a source, as one piece of a larger web he sees linking UFO secrecy to a small group of powerful people. He gives no date and no further detail.
